The '''Burlap Rug''' is a piece of [[furniture]]. It can rotate into daily stock at the [[Carpenter's Shop]] for {{Price|350}}.

It's also available from the [[Furniture Catalogue]] for {{Price|0}}.

Players who select a [[Farm Maps|Riverland]] or [[Farm Maps|Hill-top farm map]] during character creation will have one inside their house when the game begins.
